@21f3000759

I have a doubt regarding this question which asks to display the contents of data.txt with each line’s length prepended at the start of the line.

IMG-20251220-WA0012(2)1280×720 66 KB

When testing the options, none of them seem to print the length before the line for each record.

  • Option 4 prints the length after the line.
    The END block option runs only once (last line only).
  • Other options either don’t prepend or don’t match the required format.

As per awk execution and the wording of the question, it looks like none of the given options exactly satisfy the requirement.

Could you please confirm if the question has an issue or clarify which option is expected to be correct?

posts.name: Swati Jain
posts.cooked:
Yes the word END is a typo here. So, without end it works fine. This is correct awk '{print length($0), $0}' data.txt

@aloktripathi
